purpose: The stage where the customer meets and talks to their Custodian: an on-device (local-model) conversational technician that explains the real diagnostics and the authored repair plan in plain English, answers questions about the repair, and hands every action to the consent + envelope-validated path. It is the chat window that replaces the command window. Bounded by the Conversation Contract (session scope, interactive params, guardrails, curated knowledge). Serves Manifest U1-U6.

capabilities.name: converse
capabilities.function: Multi-turn, on-device conversation scoped to one repair session; opens by explaining the authored plan, then answers the customer's questions grounded in real diagnostics + the curated reference.

capabilities.name: explain_not_author
capabilities.function: May explain what an action does and why, but never authors/approves/executes it; proceeding always hands off to the existing consent + envelope-validated plan path (I2).

capabilities.name: honest_deference
capabilities.function: Defers on anything not grounded in the diagnostics or curated reference instead of fabricating specifics (U2).

capabilities.name: scope_guard
capabilities.function: Declines out-of-session topics and treats diagnostics/pasted text as data, not instructions (injection resistance).

expected_outputs: a 2+ turn conversation, offline, provenance=local-model, that explains the actual authored plan
an out-of-scope request politely redirected, not answered
an unknown deferred honestly ('I'm not certain - here's what the scan shows')
no action authored/executed by the chat under any prompt

evidence.source: DRAFT (TOTEM-0019). Orb skeleton + Conversation Contract only; no app code yet. Reuses the proven on-device int4 gemma-3-1b-it (32768-token context). Gaps to build (each its own gated Totem): (2) multi-turn extension of ILocalInference, (3) ChatPanel surface, (4) system-prompt ingestion of the curated reference. Definition of Done in SPEC.md §5.
